title: C-39: banning an account disconnects it and refuses the next login
notes: The account is created by the run and the ban is applied through the loginserver console.
The scenario records the ban and the subsequent refusal without storing a credential or client data.

steps.name: the client brings its renderer up
the login window is on the screen
the client is admitted
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the server closes the banned session
the client reports the refused session
